version_type: standalone; core v1.13.0 files unchanged; UN rows stay 1990-2020
rule: For each country, the earliest census from 1960 to 1979 with a usable origin measure for the founding pool; the actual year is shown. Founding share = share in the country's primary pool (country_pool_map.csv); "ethnic European" = EUR pool. Armenia and Georgia are pool CAU. Their baseline_founding_pct is null so the former ethnic European full-map share is not read as a Caucasus share; that former share is in alternates.former_ethnic_european_full_map_pct. Stored pool percentages in other rows were computed while Armenians and Georgians counted as ethnic European and North Caucasus peoples were unmapped. They are not recast. Current ethnic codes are in caucasus_ethnic_groups.json.
change_note: change_pp_baseline_to_latest is given only where the baseline and the core latest value use a comparable definition; otherwise null (see flags).
